summary: Fidelity International is a London-based global asset manager (~$800B AUM), separate from US Fidelity Investments. Active in tokenized collateral (JPMorgan TCN, live since June 2024). APAC digital propositions function. Sygnum tokenization partnership. Broader: active management in equities/fixed income/multi-asset, retirement solutions, outsourced CIO, sustainable investing. Benefits from Fidelity brand/ecosystem but operates independently. Key challenge: fee pressure from passive in core active management business.

business_segments.detail: Active: equities, fixed income, multi-asset, alternatives. ~$800B AUM. Strong APAC presence.

business_segments.name: Solutions & Multi-Asset
